content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary safety endpoint lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but no specific statistical analysis method is described for it in the statistical methods section; only general safety analyses are mentioned.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed analysis description for the safety endpoint, including how AEs will be summarized and compared."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Treatment response in non-injected target lesions' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Treatment response in non-injected target lesions based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This endpoint is listed but no corresponding analysis is described in the efficacy analyses section.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis method for this endpoint, including how response in non-injected lesions will be evaluated and summarized."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no PK analysis methods are described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis section detailing how concentrations will be summarized and analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Development of anti-Qb antibodies' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis method is described for it.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis for immunogenicity, including how antibody development will be summarized and compared."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory biomarker endpoints lack a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers related to TLR9, immune checkpoints, and potential markers of resistance or response to immunotherapy",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory biomarker endpoints are listed but no analysis methods are described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for biomarker endpoints, including how changes from baseline will be analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory cytokine endpoint lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The cytokine endpoint is listed but no analysis method is described.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis for cytokine changes, including statistical tests and handling of repeated measures."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: it lacks specification of the population (ITT is mentioned later but not tied to the estimand), intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death), and summary measure (proportion is implied but not formally defined).",
      "fix": "Define a full estimand for the primary endpoint, including population, variable, intercurrent event handling, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency: 69 vs 100 subjects",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 80% power to detect a difference of 13% using a 2-sided exact test with a significance level of 0.05, assuming that the null hypothesis for ORR is 7% (Hodi-2016; Ribas-2018), and the study ORR is 20%. The sample size was increased to 100 subjects to adjust for an early discontinuation rate of 15% and to allow for a robust assessment of safety.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1 Sample Size Calculation",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size calculation is based on 69 subjects, but the study enrolls 100. The text explains the increase, but the power statement is based on 69, which may be confusing; the power for 100 is not stated.",
      "fix": "Clarify the power for the final sample size of 100 or state that the power is based on the evaluable sample after discontinuations."
    }
  ]
}
